hook: Your hike in Azerbaijan ends at a burning hillside.
title: A Hillside in Azerbaijan Is On Fire
description:
Yanar Dag near Baku in Azerbaijan has flames burning straight out of the ground. Natural gas seeps up through the rock and feeds the fire. The name means burning mountain, and it has burned for decades.

#Shorts #Azerbaijan #PlacesThatShouldntExist
